# googleads_asset_group (Resource)

A Performance Max asset group — the bundle of headlines, descriptions, images, logos, and videos (linked via `googleads_asset_group_asset`) that fuels a PMax campaign's automated creative assembly. The parent campaign is immutable; name, status, URLs, and paths can be updated in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_asset_group" "main" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  campaign_id = googleads_campaign.pmax.id # a PERFORMANCE_MAX campaign
  name        = "tf-asset-group"
  status      = "PAUSED"

  final_urls = ["https://example.com"]
  path1      = "deals"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Parent PMax campaign resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `final_urls` (List of String) Landing URLs. At least one required.
- `name` (String) Asset group name (1–128 characters, unique within the campaign).

### Optional

- `final_mobile_urls` (List of String) Optional mobile-specific landing URLs.
- `path1` (String) First part of the display URL path.
- `path2` (String) Second part of the display URL path. Only valid when path1 is set.
- `status` (String) ENABLED (default), PAUSED, or REMOVED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Asset group resource name (customers/{cid}/assetGroups/{id}).
